about: The alleluia of the formulary “Saints Philip and James, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Alleluia, alleluia. The heavens will praise Your wonders, O Lord, and Your truth also in the church of the saints. Alleluia. Have I been with you so long a time, and you have not known Me? Philip, whoever sees Me sees My Father also. Alleluia.
